system.description:
You make a series of attacks with your weapon, each one using the force of the last to deliver a greater blow.

Make 3 melee Taijutsu attacks dealing your [Weapons damage] + 2d6. If at least two attacks score a hit on the same creature, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are knocked Prone and must spend their full movement to stand back up. Additionally, while Prone in this way attacks from Flail weapon against the Prone creature are made with a +2 bonus to the damage dealt.

Chain 2: A creature that fails their saving throw is also Staggered on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the damage by 1d6.
